**Step 5: Fix 6 — Right-click placement AABB check**

Confirmed: The original inside-player check (simple integer coordinate equality over 2-tall volume) has been replaced with a proper AABB overlap test:

```go
overlapX := math.Abs(float64(placedX)+0.5-(x+0.3)) < 0.3+0.5
overlapY := math.Abs(float64(placedY)+0.5-(y+0.9)) < 0.9+0.5
overlapZ := math.Abs(float64(placedZ)+0.5-(z+0.3)) < 0.3+0.5
if overlapX && overlapY && overlapZ {
    continue
}
```

This correctly models the player hitbox as radius=0.3 in XZ, height=1.8 (center at y+0.9, half-height 0.9) against a full unit cube block (half-extent 0.5 in all axes). Edge case: if the player is standing *on* the block being placed (e.g. placing at feet), the Y overlap check uses the player's center at y+0.9, so a block at placedY=y would have center y+0.5, distance |0.5-0.9|=0.4 < 0.9+0.5 ✓ — correctly blocks placing inside feet.
